note: Evidence ledger for Website V2 product claims. Sources were read read-only; no secrets or personal records were used.

items.claim: All five categories are offered both to hire directly (marketplace) and to book by the hour (on-demand), with instant, scheduled and hourly booking, in all eight cities.
items.note: Business confirmation. The code only partly reflects it — see impl.* items and CONTENT-EVIDENCE.md 'Implementation vs confirmation'.

items.claim: Nine contact plans (Home, Office, Business × 3) with the prices, contacts and validity in src/data/plans.ts.
items.note: Code serves plans from the `plan` table with an even/odd user A/B split (MeeHelp_Backend customer.php ~489-533). The app onboarding text 'Plans start at Rs 299' (User App onboarding_screen.dart:29) does not match the confirmed lowest plan (₹499).

items.claim: Part-time help can be hired for 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 or 12 hours a day.
items.note: Also helper side: lib/screens/auth/create_account/update_details_screen.dart 190-205 (Helper App). App copy: 'Hire 2 hours to 12 hours house helper from locations near you' (onboarding_screen.dart:24).

items.claim: Full-time hiring is for live-in help who stay at your home (24-hour arrangement).
items.note: Helper option 'Fixed Full time work (24 hr customer k ghar par Rehana)'. User App: 'No more paying high brokerage to hire live in helpers. Talk directly with helpers, negotiate and hire.' (app_localization.dart:49).

items.claim: When you search you choose the hours per day, the work you need, your house size (1–5 BHK) or household members (1–5), and a gender preference (male, female or no preference).
items.note: House size appears for the cleaning work type, household members for the cooking work type (IDs 6/5 — meaning inferred, medium).

items.claim: The app does NOT filter helpers by experience, age, language, religion, salary, skills or cuisine.
items.note: Negative fact used as a guard: Website V2 must never claim these filters exist (claims.ts unsupportedClaimRules).

items.claim: Helpers near your address are listed with their distance in km, and you can sort by distance or by date.
Search radius: about 20 km for part-time and 80 km for full-time helpers.
items.note: Internal tuning value; not published. The site says only that full-time (live-in) search looks further afield — and even that is not stated today.

items.claim: Helper profiles show experience, the work they do and are looking for, age, marital status, education and whether they read, write and speak English.
items.note: Profiles do not show expected salary — salary is agreed with the helper. A rating is also shown but defaults to '5' when a helper has none (helper_profile_screen.dart:210), so ratings are never used in marketing.

items.claim: 'View Contact' on a profile uses one contact from your plan; you can then call, chat or message the helper on WhatsApp from the app.
items.note: Backend: viewing inserts rt_view_provider once per helper; purchases set allowed_view_provider (customer.php ~13488-13515, ~2261-2280).

items.claim: You can arrange an interview date and time with a helper; the helper is notified in their app.
items.note: Server supports it; the current customer UI path was not traced end to end, so the site only says 'discuss and arrange a trial'.

items.claim: There is no trial feature in the app — any trial is arranged directly between customer and helper.
items.note: Site copy always words the trial as something you arrange with the helper.

items.claim: After contacting a helper you can record what happened (interviewed, hired, did not answer, did not turn up, agency/agent, wrong number).
The app advises: don't make advance payments to helpers unless they have performed the task.
Service guidelines: asking for and validating documents is the employer's responsibility, and MeeHelp recommends police verification after hiring.
items.note: Contradicts nothing the site says (the site never claims police verification), but sits uneasily beside the approved 'Aadhaar verified' wording — see open question Q-VERIFY.

items.claim: New customers get 1 free profile view.
items.note: Promotional and dynamic (Phase 4 brief): never in evergreen copy. Kept in src/data/promotions.ts.

items.claim: Helpers register for house work under 'Maid/Cook/Patient Care/Baby Care', choosing part-time or full-time (live-in) work.
items.note: No 'Elder Care' helper category exists in the helper app or the 2022 helper app (Expected Work: Cooking, Cleaning, PatientCare, BabyCare — helper/lib/user/create_account_page_two.dart ~716-841). Elder-care marketplace pages are HOLD pending confirmation (Q-ELDER).

items.claim: Category, sub-category and task names, and what each task includes, are configured on the server (admin), not in the apps.
items.sourceFile: other_section/* (categories, sub categories, category services, food types)
items.note: So detailed task lists on Website V2 are general descriptions of the role, not a copy of the app's task list. They need business review.

items.claim: One-time cleaning visits: choose at least two tasks — such as dishes, bathroom cleaning, sweeping and mopping, dusting and laundry.
items.note: 'Please select at least 2 cleaning services before continuing.' is exact (high). Task names are inferred from icon IDs 75-80 (medium). Laundry offers machine or hand wash.

items.claim: One-time cleaning visits are booked for 120, 150 or 180 minutes.
items.note: 60 and 90 min options are commented out in the app but still priced in the backend (customer.php 131-147). Treated as the current minimum duration (120 min) for one-time cleaning.

items.claim: One-time cleaning can be booked now or scheduled: up to 5 days ahead, at least an hour ahead, for start times between 7 AM and 8 PM.
items.note: Backend: 'Available between 7:00 am to 8:00 pm only.' (customer.php:14582).

items.claim: Each task shows 'What's included?' and 'What's not included?' in the app before you book.
Cleaners do not bring machines or cleaning materials.
items.note: Server text with this exact fallback; also schedule_date_time_widget.dart:321 and backend customer.php ~8013.

items.claim: Hourly bookings cover tasks such as sweeping and mopping, dusting, kitchen help, cooking, bathroom cleaning, laundry, baby care, elder care, patient care, and deep cleaning of fans, windows, balconies, the chimney or the fridge.
items.note: Task IDs 32-47 and 81-90 mapped to icons (babyCareIcon=37, elderCareIcon=38, patientCareIcon=39). Names are inferred from icons; the live names come from the server.

items.claim: Hourly bookings are for 2 to 12 hours, in 2-hour steps (minimum 2 hours). Later start times allow shorter bookings only.
items.note: Slot table is hardcoded: e.g. 07:00 allows [2…12] hours, 19:00-20:00 allow [2] only.

items.claim: Hourly bookings are scheduled at least 2 hours ahead and up to 5 days ahead, for start times between 7 AM and 8 PM.
In the current app, 'Book Now' (instant) exists for one-time cleaning; hourly bookings (including baby, elder and patient care) are scheduled only.
items.note: The business confirmed instant booking for all five categories. Until the app shows it, Website V2 copy for babysitter, elder care and patient care describes scheduled booking only (Q-INSTANT).

items.claim: Cooking can be booked as an hourly task; the app asks how many household members to cook for (1–5).
items.note: Cooking also appears as a one-time task (icon 79). Members 1–5 drive price (backend rt_member_new_price).

items.claim: You can ask for a male or female helper; the extra charge applies only if a helper of that gender is assigned, otherwise the first available helper comes.
items.note: Charge amount comes from the server (fallback ₹100) — not published.

items.claim: Helper details are shown after you pay; the helper starts the job with a PIN you share.
items.note: Backend: 4-digit job OTP verified before the job moves to In-Progress (customer.php ~10724, ~12753-12795). Helpers also upload a selfie before the start OTP (Helper App home_controller.dart ~332-337).

items.claim: Part of the booking amount is paid online in the app; the rest is paid to the helper after the service.
items.note: Exact split depends on server commission settings and a city-level 'commission-free' mode. Not stated on the site until the business confirms the wording.

items.claim: On-demand prices are set on the server (hourly rates, member/house-size prices, discounts, platform fee).
items.note: Hardcoded cleaning price table is non-monotonic (120 min cheaper than 90 min) and the app shows different GST fallbacks (5% vs 18%). On-demand prices therefore stay UNKNOWN on Website V2.

items.claim: After a helper accepts your booking, cancelling is not refunded; cancelling two accepted bookings limits the account to paid-only bookings for 30 days.
items.note: Pre-acceptance policy text comes from the server; backend policy copy has more windows (customer.php ~8005-8075). Not published until the business gives one authoritative policy.

items.claim: There is no rescheduling feature; a booking is cancelled and re-booked.
The app has no live helper tracking or SOS button for customers.
items.note: Guard: the site must not claim tracking or SOS.

items.claim: Customers and helpers sign in with a mobile number verified by OTP.
items.note: Approved wording 'Mobile number verified by OTP' (src/data/verification.ts).

items.claim: Helpers submit Aadhaar for verification (front and back images read in the app, then reviewed; an Aadhaar OTP route also exists on the server).
items.note: Approved wording 'Aadhaar verified'. Caveats for the business: the upload endpoint sets the verified flag on upload (provider.php ~768-812) and the in-app Aadhaar-OTP screen is commented out; admins can also verify manually. 'Only verified profiles will get orders.' applies to on-demand orders. The customer app shows no verification badge.

items.claim: Helpers give their address with a map location when they register.
items.note: Supports the approved 'Current address on record'. A separate PERMANENT address is not visible in the current helper app (one address only; backend has staying_currently/current_city fields). Q-ADDRESS.

items.claim: Helpers take a live photo (blink check) at registration and a selfie before starting each on-demand job.
items.note: Not yet in the approved verification list — candidate for approval.

items.claim: MeeHelp does not carry out police verification.
items.note: 'Meehelp will conduct the basic document verification which does not include police verification.' Consistent with the current guidelines (mkt.employer-checks). Police/background claims stay blocked.

items.claim: Ratings are not a reliable public signal: missing ratings display as 5 (customer app) or are stored as 4 (backend).
items.note: Reason ratings, review counts and AggregateRating stay off Website V2.

items.claim: In-app support is on WhatsApp, 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM.
items.note: The inAppSupport claim stays disabled until the business confirms channels and hours (src/data/business.ts).

items.claim: Customers can report a helper; reported helpers no longer appear in that customer's search.
Coverage is checked against your address (city, pincode and map location) in the app; the app tells you if your area isn't served.
items.note: Backend: rt_service_cities + rt_allowed_cities bounding boxes; no locality list (customer.php ~14408-14473). So the site never lists localities as served.

items.claim: The customer app is in English only.
items.note: And helper profiles record only English reading/speaking, not other languages — so city pages no longer talk about local languages.

items.claim: Elder care and patient care use the same pool of care helpers on the marketplace side; elder care is a customer need mapped to that pool, not a separate helper category.
items.note: Reconciles cat.helper-categories (helper app lists Patient Care only). Site copy says elder care and patient care attendants come from the same pool and never claims a separate elder-care category.

items.claim: Instant (Book Now) booking exists only for one-time cleaning; hourly, care and other hourly services are scheduled, not instant.
items.note: Confirms impl.instant-scope (code). Supersedes the Phase 4 confirmation of instant booking for every category.

items.claim: The helper's Aadhaar document is collected and manually reviewed by MeeHelp. Aadhaar OTP / electronic verification is not the normal active process and must not be claimed.
items.note: Matches the helper app (document upload + 'completed within 24 hours'; OTP screen commented out). Wording: 'Aadhaar document collected and manually reviewed'.

items.claim: The address MeeHelp holds is the one on the submitted Aadhaar document; MeeHelp does not independently verify a separate current or permanent address.
items.note: Disables the Phase 3 'current/permanent address on record' checks.

items.claim: 'Plans start at Rs 299' in the app is stale; the lowest current Home plan is ₹499.
items.note: Guarded: ₹299 must not appear in Website V2 (claims.ts stalePricePattern).

items.claim: Baby care / babysitter / nanny scope: infant hygiene and physical care, feeding and meal support, sleep and routine, development and engagement, baby-area upkeep — framed by parental instructions and agreed scope.
items.note: Rendered from src/data/care-scope.ts. No medical, developmental or safety guarantees; nannies are not described as paediatric professionals.

items.claim: Elder care daily-living / attendant support: bathing, grooming, dressing, oral hygiene, toileting, bedpans, adult diapers, mobility and transfers, walking, repositioning, feeding, meal preparation, light housekeeping, laundry/linen, errands, companionship, reading, short walks, accompanying to appointments.

Elder care special care, only where an appropriately trained professional is specifically engaged: medication support, BP / blood sugar / oxygen / temperature checks, prescribed rehabilitation exercises, dementia/Alzheimer's support; wound dressing, bed-sore care and catheter-related support.
items.note: Published with 'only when a caregiver trained for this is specifically engaged'. Wound, bed-sore and catheter items stay REVIEW-ONLY (clinicalServices.woundAndCatheter = false) until the training/credential pathway is confirmed.

items.claim: Injections, insulin administration and IV lines were mentioned in the business description of elder care.
items.note: NOT published: requires certainty about qualifications, credentialing, clinical responsibility and operational scope. Blocked by clinicalServices.invasive = false and clinicalClaimFindings().

items.claim: Patient care scope: personal care (bathing/sponge bath, grooming, dressing, adult diapers, bedpans), mobility (transfers, supported walking, repositioning), feeding and hydration, reminders for prescribed oral medicines, monitoring where the caregiver is trained (temperature, BP, basic observations — reporting, not diagnosis), companionship and patient-area upkeep.
Standard patient care does not include injections, IV drips or invasive medical procedures, and is not nursing.
One-time cleaning ('On the go') tasks include Kitchen Prep/Cleaning, Laundry (machine wash), Dishes, Bathroom (number of bathrooms), Sweeping/Mopping and Dusting (house size in BHK).
items.note: Confirms od.otg-tasks (code, medium). The screenshots also show a customer address and wallet balance — not recorded.

items.claim: One-time cleaning visits of 120, 150 and 180 minutes, with both 'Book Now' and 'Schedule' offered.
'Cleaners will not be carrying any machines or materials.' banner on the one-time cleaning order screens.

One-time cleaning: 'Pay Now (Online)' — 'This amount is required to confirm your order'; 'Pay After Service (Cash)' — 'Pay directly to the helper after job completion'. Wallet balance can be used for the online part.
items.note: Scoped to the one-time cleaning flow only; never applied to marketplace plans or hourly bookings on the site.

items.claim: Observed: online amount = platform fee of ~20% of the service value + 5% GST on that fee (₹598 → ₹120 + ₹5.98; ₹665 → ₹133 + ₹6.65; ₹720 → ₹144 + ₹7.20). The cash balance is the service value minus the online amount, rounded (₹472, ₹525, ₹569).
items.note: Consistent with backend code for this flow (OTG commission 20, gst 5 — customer.php ~4233, ~4311-4320). NOT a universal rule: backend hourly commission differs (15; scheduled payout 70/25), a city-level commission-free mode exists, and no tax statement is approved. Not published; no tax wording on the site.

items.claim: Observed one-time cleaning service values: 120 min ₹598 (₹650, 8% off), 150 min ₹665 (₹700, 5% off), 180 min ₹720 (₹800, 10% off).
items.note: Match the hardcoded backend table (customer.php 131-147: 120→650, 150→700, 180→800; discounts 8/5/10). Discounts are promotional. Kept in src/data/observed-app-values.ts, never in evergreen copy, titles or metas.

items.claim: Observed 'Select Schedule' options: 2/4/6/8/10/12 hours at ₹598/₹755/₹936/₹1,360/₹1,480/₹1,890 (previous ₹650/₹850/₹1,300/₹1,600/₹1,850/₹2,100); gender preference +₹100; house size selector.
items.note: Hour options confirm od.hourly-durations (published). Amounts are server values (rt_hour_rate) for one address/date — not universal across cities, categories or promotions. Not published.

items.claim: One-time cleaning cancellation policy: before a helper accepts — 'Order auto cancels because no helper was assigned. Refund: 100% to original payment source processed in 2-7 working days'; after a helper accepted — 'No Refund'.
items.note: Published narrowly: the refund applies to an auto-cancellation when no helper was assigned — not to every cancellation before acceptance. Rescheduling stays unknown.

openQuestions.question: Are the observed one-time-cleaning and hourly prices stable and the same in every city and category? Until confirmed they stay out of evergreen copy.
openQuestions.affects: Any future price mention on on-demand pages

openQuestions.question: Is 'platform fee ≈ 20% of the service value + 5% GST on the fee' the authoritative rule for one-time cleaning in every city? The backend uses different commission values for hourly bookings and has a commission-free mode.
What happens if the customer cancels before a helper accepts (not an auto-cancellation)? And do hourly bookings follow the same policy?
openQuestions.affects: Cancellation wording (published narrowly for one-time cleaning)

openQuestions.question: Can a booking be rescheduled? No rescheduling feature was found in the app.
Confirm the training/credential pathway for wound dressing, bed-sore and catheter support, and for injections, insulin and IV lines, before any of them is published.
openQuestions.affects: Elder and patient care scope (review-only / clinical-approval items)

openQuestions.question: Which category or 'expected work' option does a customer pick in the app to find an elder care attendant?
Approve the task names used on the website (the live names are configured in admin).

resolvedQuestions.resolution: Elder care and patient care share one care-helper pool; elder care is a customer need, not a separate category.
Instant booking is one-time cleaning only; hourly and care bookings are scheduled.
Aadhaar document collected and manually reviewed; no electronic verification claims.
Address is the one on the Aadhaar document; no separate current/permanent address claims.
₹299 is stale; the lowest Home plan is ₹499.
Business supplied the baby, elder and patient care scopes.
